title: 반응형 요금제 카드
trap_note: naive fixed-px inline-block row with no media query passes the visible 'three cards render' check but fails hidden: no <768px stacking (responsive), unequal card widths, the featured card is not visually distinguished, and missing button text / heading semantics trip axe-core. A correct solution needs flex/grid + a media query + accessible markup.
